prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one complete full-bleed portrait 2:3 tarot illustration, Seven of Swords. The first 1 reference image(s) are exact Dragon Quest character identity/costume references; the LAST is ONLY the approved deck ink/color/texture style, not a scene or person to copy.
Scene and exact characters: Actual DQXI Erik: tall swept-up spiky pale blue hair, green hooded tunic, magenta sash, blue-gray trousers and brown boots as official. In a quiet old fortress garden, he moves carefully while carrying exactly FIVE clearly separate steel swords bundled across his arms. Exactly TWO additional swords remain planted in the ground behind him; total SEVEN swords. Each has a visible distinct hilt; no daggers/hilts on his belt, no other weapons. Thoughtful strategy rather than violence, a sideways alert glance, sunny blue-sky Dragon Quest landscape. No victims, text, numbers or frame.
Shared deck art direction: faithfully drawn Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest characters, clean confident black ink outlines, expressive recognizable faces, crisp hand-painted cel color blocks, restrained shadows and a subtle watercolor-paper grain matching the approved illustration. Original illustration, NOT a 3D screenshot, product photograph, plush, collage or card mockup. Full-bleed single cohesive artwork edge to edge, mobile-readable clear silhouettes and large key symbols.
Hard constraints: no title, no typography, no letters or numerals, no UI, no watermark/logo, no borders or card frame. Any writing, decorative labels, copyright line, duplicate background portraits or layout boxes on reference sheets must NOT appear. Preserve actual named DQ characters, hairstyle/clothing/colors, not generic original substitutes. Keep the stated number of tarot objects exact; avoid incidental extra cups/swords/coins/wands. Do not mix in characters from other franchises.
visual_review: Erik identity retained, exactly five carried swords with five visible hilts and two left planted behind, seven total. No extra personal weapon, no text/frame.
